svg.title: Capture
svg.desc: Command: screenshot [path], What it does: The viewport, the whole page with --full, or one element with --target. PNG or JPEG; base64 when no path is given.; Command: pdf <path>, What it does: The whole page as one tall PDF page, with selectable text and working links.; Command: record start, record stop, record status, What it does: Explicit bounded PNG-sequence recording; start requires a new --path directory.; Command: processes, What it does: Native physical footprint and cumulative CPU by unique owned or attributed PID; tab mapping and explicit coverage gaps. Samples may be cached for two seconds; CPU is not per-tab utilization.; Command: inspector [--stop], What it does: Token-protected loopback dashboard, on-demand frames and human takeover.; Command: diagnose --path <file>, What it does: Metadata-only diagnostic bundle, at most 512 KiB, mode 0600.
